summary: Moraine is a Hearthian who sits on a platform atop the tallest tree in the Village to listen to Travelers' music on their Signalscope. They stay in the tree to keep Marl from cutting it down.

behavior: Moraine enjoys using the Signalscope to pick up sounds from distant planets.
Moraine refuses to let Tephra and Galena borrow their Signalscope for hide-and-seek, considering it too delicate to be thrown around.
location: Moraine is found on a platform atop the tallest tree in the Village on Timber Hearth.
Moraine chose the tree platform for its view of the planets.
lore: Moraine keeps their Signalscope tuned to the Outer Wilds Ventures frequency to hear the Travelers' music.
Moraine recently heard Riebeck's banjo coming from Brittle Hollow and took it as a sign Riebeck is safe.
Moraine notes that which planets are audible depends on time of day, since different planets are in the sky at different times.
Moraine stays in the tree as much as possible to prevent Marl from cutting it down.
Moraine knows Mayor Rutile has told Marl not to cut the tree down, but doubts Marl and Rutile agree on it.
